title: AutoSynthData: Generating Training Data for Enterprise Agents
summary: AutoSynthData addresses the challenge of generating high-quality training data for enterprise AI agents, where real-world data is scarce, sensitive, or expensive to label. It likely provides a framework or pipeline for synthesizing task-oriented trajectories and tool-use examples, enabling fine-tuning of agentic LLMs on domain-specific workflows without relying on proprietary production logs.
